evidence.supports: Plaintiff raised attorneys' fees in its opening term sheet.

evidence.quote: we propose a $32 million class fund, with the $5 million fee request subject to court approval and any amount not awarded going to the class.
evidence.supports: Fees were negotiated before class relief was settled.

evidence.quote: Term sheet: class fund $30,000,000; attorneys' fees $5,000,000; clear sailing yes; unawarded fees revert to defendant no; distribution automatic
evidence.supports: Fees and class relief remained part of the negotiated term sheets before acceptance.

summary: Plaintiff class counsel first raised fee terms in the opening proposal, and fees were negotiated alongside class relief before the final class fund was accepted. The transcript does not clearly show a trade of lower class relief for higher or unopposed fees, plaintiff self-interest, defense exploitation of fee interests, reverse-auction tactics, or a misleading declaration.
